title: SSB HC (Ministerial) Answer Key 2026 – Re-Open
postName: Head Constable (Ministerial) – CBT Answer Key / Objection Re-Open
vacancyDetails: Answer key objection portal re-opened for Head Constable (Ministerial) CBT; one-day extension as per SSB notice
qualification: Intermediate / as per SSB HC Ministerial notification
ageLimit: As per SSB HC Ministerial recruitment rules
selectionProcess: CBT → Skill / further stages → Physical → Medical → DV
documentsRequired: Admit card, registration credentials, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in or ssb.gov.in
2. Open HC (Ministerial) Answer Key / Objection portal
3. Login with credentials
4. View response sheet and provisional key
5. Submit objections during re-opened window (e.g. from 14 July 2026 as notified)
shortDescription: SSB HC (Ministerial) Answer Key 2026 objection portal re-opened for one day. Check recruitment.ssb.gov.in for response sheet and challenges.
content:
Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) has released / re-opened the Head Constable (Ministerial) answer key objection facility.

Provisional key was issued around 9 July 2026. Objection management portal was extended for one additional day (around mid-July 2026) for candidates to raise queries on CBT answers.

Use only official portal recruitment.ssb.gov.in.
